You have also learned about modulator and demodulator circuits.
These circuits are not complex! You know about filter, oscillator, and amplifier circuits.

A receiver will contain a tuning circuit to pick out the AM signal, an RF amplifier to amplify the weak received AM signal, a demodulator to recover the information, and one or more additional amplifier circuits for the information signal.
At a minimum, a transmitter will contain an oscillator circuit to generate the carrier frequency, a modulator circuit to produce the AM signal, and one or more stages of amplifier circuits.
AM transmitters and receivers contain more than just a modulator and demodulator.
